# Implementation based on specification
    import re
    # Define unit seconds mapping
    unit_seconds = {suffix: size for suffix, size in _UNITS}
    order = {suffix: idx for idx, (suffix, _) in enumerate(_UNITS)}
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("empty duration string")
    # Pure integer without unit -> seconds
    if text.isdigit():
        return int(text)
    # We'll parse sequentially, allowing optional whitespace between components
    i = 0
    total = 0
    last_idx = -1
    seen = set()
    length = len(text)
    while i < length:
        # skip whitespace
        if text[i].isspace():
            i += 1
            continue
        # parse number
        if not text[i].isdigit():
            raise ValueError(f"invalid duration component at position {i}: '{text[i:]}'")
        start = i
        while i < length and text[i].isdigit():
            i += 1
        number = int(text[start:i])
        if i >= length:
            raise ValueError("unit missing after number")
        unit = text[i].lower()
        i += 1
        if unit not in unit_seconds:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown unit '{unit}'")
        idx = order[unit]
        # enforce decreasing order and single occurrence
        if idx <= last_idx:
            raise ValueError("units not in decreasing order or repeated")
        if unit in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate unit")
        seen.add(unit)
        last_idx = idx
        total += number * unit_seconds[unit]
    return total
